name: capy-springs
description: Capy Springs - a one-thumb offline arcade-idle onsen builder (vanilla Canvas JS, no dependencies)

scripts.test: node test/headless.js --seconds 6000 && node test/headless.js --season 2 --seconds 2400 && node test/headless.js --fuzz 300 && node test/headless.js --fuzz 300 --season 2
scripts.native: node tools/pack.js && node tools/native_assets.js && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --android --iconBackgroundColor "#FFC857" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#FFC857" --splashBackgroundColor "#F6F1E7" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#F6F1E7" && npx cap sync
